notes.title: ARMORED HEAD
notes.content:
A new game is out today. Miniature shooter in the arena with robots. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/805590/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28350442/69d73ce86205494fe60b45e117e74c287e84f5a1.jpg[/img][/url]

If you remember the strange robots heads in Scene 7 of Fibrillation, then this is exactly where the new game came from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28350442/f1b1cfad9d5ec0767252358867dd8b5159c7543e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/805590/

notes.title: 1.87 Added camera control from the keyboard
notes.content:
Now the camera in the game can be controlled from the keyboard using the numpad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28350442/726cfaf702471de76909ad3456c3c7ac0ec93fec.jpg[/img]
[i]Some keyboards do not allow you to press multiple keys at the same time. Therefore, if you encounter problems while moving forward with acceleration and simultaneous rotation of the camera, you can reassign the Run key from the shift to some other.[/i]
